name: mimorii
description: Self-hosted uptime, infrastructure analytics, and observability.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run build && pnpm run agent-desktop:build && pnpm run agent-mobile:build
scripts.check: pnpm run release:validate && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present run test && pnpm run agent-desktop:test && pnpm run agent-mobile:test
scripts.tauri:android:init: pnpm run release:validate && pnpm --filter @mimorii/client tauri:android:init && node scripts/configure-android-project.mjs client
scripts.tauri:android:client:build: pnpm run release:validate && node scripts/build-android-app.mjs client
scripts.tauri:android:client:release: pnpm run tauri:android:client:build && pnpm run tauri:android:client:sign
scripts.tauri:android:agent:build: pnpm run release:validate && node scripts/build-android-app.mjs agent
scripts.tauri:android:agent:release: pnpm run tauri:android:agent:build && pnpm run tauri:android:agent:sign
scripts.tauri:android:release: pnpm run tauri:android:client:release && pnpm run tauri:android:agent:release
